detailed_descriptions.en: Make the most of your journey through the frozen wasteland with the Permafrost - Official Companion! Crafted to be the perfect companion to Permafrost, this official guide provides helpful tips, useful information and additional insights to support you as you explore a world locked in ice, gather vital resources and fight to survive in unforgiving conditions. Whether you're taking your first steps into the frozen wilderness or want to deepen your knowledge of the game, the Official Companion is a useful reference to keep by your side throughout your journey. Discover helpful advice, learn more about surviving in a world transformed by the cold and get the most out of your journey through the frozen remains of civilization with the Permafrost: Official Companion! Please note: This is a digital companion book and does not include the Permafrost base game. Only available in English and German.
